paragraphs: Rav Chana bar Chinena asked Rav Huna: Pesachim 106b. “R. Chana bar Chanina said: Joseph hid three treasures”—Chelek, 110a. Pesachim 119a has “R. Achai bar Chanina said”; Yalkut, end of Vayigash, has “R. Chama bar Chanina said.”
